senses.example: Quiero devolver esta camisa, me queda pequeña.
senses.exampleGloss: I want to return this shirt, it is too small for me.

alternatives.reason: Returning money as change, not returning a purchase.
LatAm-leaning in this sense; in Spain regresar is usually to go back.

notes: devolver algo a alguien; devolver el dinero. Irregular: devuelvo.
